scripts.test: if [ -n "$BT_COVERAGE_SHARD" ]; then vitest run --shard=$BT_COVERAGE_SHARD --reporter=blob --reporter=dot --silent=passed-only --coverage ${BT_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS:+--maxWorkers=$BT_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS} && { [ "${BT_COVERAGE_SHARD%%/*}" != 1 ] || vitest run --config vitest.workers.config.ts --reporter=dot --silent=passed-only; }; elif [ -n "$BT_FUNCTIONS_SHARDED" ]; then echo "@bt/functions: tests skipped here, CI runs them in its shard jobs (BT_FUNCTIONS_SHARDED)"; else vitest run --coverage --coverage.reporter=text-summary --coverage.reporter=json-summary --reporter=dot --silent=passed-only ${BT_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS:+--maxWorkers=$BT_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS} && vitest run --config vitest.workers.config.ts --reporter=dot --silent=passed-only; fi
